request.title: What do users get after closing the out-of-credits paywall?
request.why: It decides how generous the free tier is, which shapes revenue and reviews.

options.label: Watch an ad for one more credit

request.rec_reason: Ads clash with the calm brand; a daily refill keeps people coming back.

response.note: Neither exactly. Give one free credit back after they invite a friend, max once a day. That gives us distribution and still feels generous.
